headings: Accountant Sends Invoice and Receives Payment
text: **(Billing)** When shipment is marked as Packed: Accountant creates an invoice and sends it to Bill-To Customer for the relevant order(s). When payment is received from Bill-To Customer, Accountant associates it with relevant invoice(s) and marks invoices with full payment as paid.
limitation: Read-only screen/dialog evidence only. Prerequisite creation, field input, submissions, integrations and full story transitions are not executed.
